INSERT INTO wo_cell_change_log ( SHEET_SEQ, ROW_NO, COLUMN_NO, CHANGE_TYPE, ORG_VALUE, MOD_VALUE, INPUT_DATETIME, INPUT_USER ) VALUES
(#{log.sheetSeq}, #{log.rowNo}, #{log.columnNo}, #{log.changeType}, CAST(#{log.orgValue} AS jsonb), CAST(#{log.modValue} AS jsonb), CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, #{userKey})
mapper.select: SELECT L.LOG_SEQ, L.INPUT_DATETIME AS CHANGED_AT, L.INPUT_USER AS CHANGED_USER FROM wo_cell_change_log L JOIN wo_workbook_sheet_line S ON S.SHEET_SEQ = L.SHEET_SEQ WHERE S.WORKBOOK_SEQ = #{workbookSeq} AND L.DEL_DATETIME IS NULL ORDER BY L.LOG_SEQ DESC FETCH FIRST #{limit} ROWS ONLY
